run.title: Regime-3 task hunt
run.subtitle: Finding a real-activation task where temporal crosscoders win decisively — not marginally
run.phase: Phase 2 — candidate 4 gate running (layer 8); oracle-pair diagnostic queued
run.prime_directive: A sound verdict, never a win. Cards are frozen (committed) before any screen runs; git order is the evidence. Falsified predictions are scored as falsified.

why: NeurIPS submission 26867 drew one converging complaint across all three reviewers plus the meta-review: the paper never demonstrates that temporal aggregation (specifically, cross-position weight sharing) is responsible for its gains.
bbby: the isolating baseline (Stacked SAE) exists in App. A but is absent from Fig. 4 / Table 2; MLC — cross-layer, not temporal — wins sparse probing, and window length barely matters there.
4z15 (accept): can you isolate the temporal contribution from generic crosscoder capacity?
EAxU (strong reject): results seem preliminary; marginal improvement over T-SAE and MLC; TXC is motivated primarily by backtracking.
The paper's own Limitations section concedes the root cause: we cannot yet predict in advance which real-world tasks will favor TXCs.
context.diagnosis: Every real task in TempBench sits in regime 1 or 2 of the synthetic program's coordinate system: the latent is either per-token-readable (nobody separates) or linear-in-window (every window arch ties). Regime 3 — latents needing cross-position comparison — is the only regime that separates window architectures from each other, and the paper's own architecture is the unique family that can read it.

two_filters.name: Conversion
two_filters.statement: The screening question is: will the model decline to maintain this as a per-position state? Anything generatively useful at the probe position is linearized per-position by mid-depth. Five of six round-1 candidates died here (forbidden-word onset: per-token climbs 0.538 → 0.668 with depth while the window gap never opens).

two_filters.name: The additive-code theorem
two_filters.statement: Per-token SAE, T-SAE, Stacked and TXC-pre codes are all additive over per-position features. For any per-position functions a_t, cov(Σ_t a_t(m_t), τ) = 0 term-by-term when marginals are balanced ⇒ equality-pattern latents are invisible to every additive code, at any capacity (measured: |τ| ≤ 0.02 at d_sae=40, T=8). TXC-post — the paper's Eq. 1 — is the one family whose nonlinearity crosses positions, making it a coincidence detector (τ = 0.66, c_t = 0.90).

context.design_rule: Target a label that is an equality / match between positions with balanced per-position marginals. Then five of six architectures sit at a provable chance floor and only TXC-post can read it — which is simultaneously bbby's missing ablation, 4z15's isolation request, and the missing theory EAxU wants. It is also immune to the strongest hostile objection ("just mean-pool the per-token codes"): pooling is additive, so it cannot compute equality either.

candidates.name: Role / provenance on style-mismatched spans
candidates.why: Best risk profile in the set: per-token provably lacks the evidence (the role-confusion result — role is perceived from how text sounds, not from its label) while the window provably contains it (the delimiter is a literal token in it). Failure mode is a positional caveat, not a null.

candidates.name: Instruction↔action match (agentic goal-drift)
candidates.why: Purest instance of both filters: the model has no generative reason to verify its own compliance (weakest conversion pressure in the set) and the label is an equality ⇒ theorem-protected. Risks: instruction may fall outside T; forced mismatch may register as generic surprise.

candidates.name: Injection-compliance anticipation
candidates.why: Anticipation is the only class with a positive order receipt in this program (RECORD § 3: ordered − shuffled = +0.028…+0.041 on ant_kw vs +0.003…+0.013 ambient) and satisfies the round-1 criterion: a hazard over the trajectory, not a fact the model tracks. Likely regime-2 though ⇒ a λ̂-sized win unless boundary configuration carries it.
candidates.assets: needs rollouts; exact witness-string labels, zero API

candidates.name: Contradiction / fact-consistency XOR
candidates.why: Cheapest decisive experiment in the set; provable chance floor for five archs. Main risk: the LM may linearize mismatch as surprise at the second mention ⇒ per-token wins ⇒ clean publishable negative.

candidates.name: Agreement attraction (number-match XOR)
candidates.why: Same theorem protection, most legible phenomenon to reviewers, and per-token is actively misled by the distractor. But subject number must be maintained for generation ⇒ real conversion pressure; expect 0.75 vs 0.92 rather than chance vs 0.9.

candidates.name: Refusal→comply order flip
candidates.why: Order-sensitive and safety-meaningful, but it is arrangement, not equality — additive codes with position-specific encoders read arrangement fine, so TXC-pre/Stacked would not be floored.

candidates.name: Winograd / ordinal antecedent
candidates.why: Elegant twin-pair control, but binding IDs are assigned roughly by order of mention, so referent → ordinal is plausibly already per-token readable at the disambiguator. Converted.

candidates.name: Filler–gap / island licensing
candidates.why: An open wh-dependency shifts the next-token distribution at every intervening position — that is how wh-licensing is measured — making it the canonical maintained state, same family as the ledger's DEAD D5 bracket/indent tracking.

candidates.name: Turn-identity match, tag-stripped dialogue
candidates.why: Equality label with exact labels and a corpus already built (dialevel), but strict alternation makes speaker ≈ parity = a position artifact, and style is ambient.

candidates.name: Multi-turn escalation / sandbagging onset
candidates.why: Right kind of latent (trajectory hazard), wrong economics: needs organisms or a paid judge, and labels get noisy.

candidate_note: p_win / p_violent are PRIORS — calibrated judgments recorded before any measurement, so the gate can score them. p_violent means a separation of at least 0.2 with the additive families at or near their floor. Nothing in this column is data.

expectations.what: Additive archs on a balanced-marginal equality label
expectations.why: The additive-code theorem. If Stacked or TXC-pre reads the label, the balance construction is broken — audit the stimuli, do not reinterpret.

expectations.what: Per-token AUC across depth with the window gap

anomalies.expectation: the layer-0 positive control should reproduce on candidate 4
anomalies.observed: contradiction at layer 0 is at chance in EVERY arm, including the window MLP at T=64 (0.506)
anomalies.disposition: NOT read as 'not represented'. At T=64 the MLP has 262,144 inputs against ~3,800 training rows — the probe-capacity confound of RECORD § 3c. An oracle-pair arm was added (the two constituent positions only, 8,192 features) to settle it. Candidate 5's control worked because its constituents are 7 tokens apart, not 26.

anomalies.expectation: E2 (additive arms at chance on a balanced equality label)
anomalies.observed: v1 stimuli: every arm at AUC 1.000, including windows that could not see constituent A
anomalies.disposition: CORRECTLY read as a stimulus defect, not a result. v1 emitted 2,400 rows from only 80 DISTINCT texts (60× duplication) — a 16k-dim probe memorises the ~16 test points (the signed_motion lesson). Rebuilt at 5,760/4,800 all-distinct items across 24/20 lexical groups; distinct-text equality is now an assertion in the generator. v1 numbers discarded, not reinterpreted.

anomalies.expectation: IN/OUT control (a window that cannot see A cannot bind)
anomalies.observed: v1: flat = 1.000 in the OUT stratum at T=4 with A at distance 6–7
anomalies.disposition: This is the control doing its job — it exposed the memorisation before any verdict was written. Kept as the standing causal check.

anomalies.observed: AutoTokenizer returned the SLOW LlamaTokenizer while reporting is_fast=True; offsets overlapped ((11,14),(13,14)) and every row was rejected
anomalies.disposition: Exactly the trap documented in task_hunt/RECORD.md § 4 note 5. `is_fast` is not a valid guard, so the gate now VALIDATES offsets (monotone, non-overlapping, exact span recovery) and uses PreTrainedTokenizerFast.

anomalies.expectation: the gate can detect regime-3 headroom
anomalies.observed: design error in MY gate: a linear probe on the flattened window is itself additive over per-position features
anomalies.disposition: Corrected mid-run. A linear flatten can never certify what only a coincidence code could read, so MLP arms were added and the headline statistic changed to nonlinear_residual = window_MLP − additive ceiling. This is the quantity the theorem actually speaks to.

anomalies.observed: 12.0 GB free after the 15 GB model pull — at the abort floor
anomalies.disposition: Held, not breached. Scan found nothing of mine to delete: the large items (/workspace/ocean 76 GB, Qwen2.5-Coder 15 GB, role-probes venvs 16.6 GB) belong to your other work. gemma (5 GB) would still fit if its licence is accepted.

log.text: Reviews + paper read. Selection principle derived from the repo's own results: violent separation requires a regime-3 (equality-pattern) latent, because that is where four of five baselines are provably — not merely empirically — floored.

Ranked the ten candidates by P(win) and P(violent win). The user's syntax suggestions (islands/filler-gap, Winograd) rank 7–8 of 10, below the safety candidates: both are plausibly converted, and the reason is recorded so the ranking can be scored later.

Gate written. Reuses the frozen problib probe stack; the local score-returning variant is asserted equal to problib's AUC to 1e-6 before any result is written. Every AUC carries a 1000-resample bootstrap CI; every cell carries a 4-draw permutation null.

v1 stimuli DISCARDED: 2,400 rows but 80 distinct texts. The IN/OUT control caught it — windows that could not see constituent A still scored 1.000. Rebuilt with full lexical diversity; distinct-text equality is now asserted in the generator.

Corrected a design error in my own gate: a linear probe on a flattened window IS an additive-over-position code, so it cannot certify regime-3 headroom. Added MLP arms; the headline is now nonlinear_residual = window_MLP − max(window_linear, per_token) — the gap only a position-mixing code can linearise.

CANDIDATE 5 KILLED (agreement attraction). Per-token linear reads match/mismatch at AUC 1.000 at layer 8; every window arm ties it; nonlinear residual −0.000 against a 3σ null of 0.008–0.075. Both pre-registered kill rules fire. My prior (0.30 violent, 'expect 0.75 vs 0.92') is falsified in the more-converted direction and scored as falsified.

Candidate-4 card FROZEN and committed (74df8f7f) before its first cell exists — predictions P1–P5 and kill rules K1/K2 are git-provable. The card states plainly that I expect this candidate to be killed too, and why running it is still correct.

POSITIVE CONTROL FOUND. At layer 0 the additive arms sit at chance (0.495 / 0.503) while the window MLP reaches 0.749 — and only when the window reaches constituent A (OUT stratum: 0.498). The additive-code theorem, measured on real activations, and proof the gate can detect regime-3 headroom when it exists.

Depth curve: per-token 0.495 (L0) → 0.983 (L2) → 1.000 (L4→L24). Conversion within four layers — far faster than the forbidden-word candidate's ~20-layer climb. This is why the kill is a statement about the model rather than the instrument.
Candidate 4 (contradiction) now caching on the frozen card: layers 0/8/16/24 × T ∈ {8,16,32,64}. Layer 0 is included precisely because it is now a known positive control.

Retrospective card written for candidate 5 with its weak provenance stated up front: it was authored after the pilot, so only the artifact timestamp and plan file pre-date the run. The contradiction card is the properly frozen template.

Candidate 4's layer-0 control is at chance in every arm including the window MLP at T=64 — but with 262k features against ~3.8k rows that is a probe-capacity statement, not a representational one. Added an oracle-pair arm (two constituent positions only) rather than reading the null at face value.
Candidate 4 now at layer 8. Resource receipts so far: peak probe VRAM 7.87 GB against the 60 GB guard, zero OOM events, disk holding at 12.4 GB.

figures.caption: Candidate 5 (agreement attraction), R1-Distill-Llama-8B, T=8, merged across two runs. LEFT: at the embedding layer the per-token probe (blue, occluded by orange where they coincide) and the window LINEAR probe both sit at chance — the additive-code theorem, measured on real activations — while the window MLP reaches 0.75. By layer 4 all three are pinned at 1.000. RIGHT: the regime-3 headroom is +0.27 at layer 0 and ONLY when the window reaches the head noun; the A-outside-window control sits inside the null band. Shaded bands are bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples); grey band is ±3σ of the label-permutation null.

Same candidate at layer 16: neither statistic leaves the null band at any window size, in either stratum. Note the left panel dipping below zero — a fixed-budget linear probe pays a dimensionality cost as T grows, the same effect recorded in task_hunt/RECORD.md § 1.

triage.note: Label-side triage — free kill authority, run before any GPU spend. By construction the label must be unreadable from either constituent alone, from length, or from filler count. This is expectation E1. v2 additionally asserts distinct_texts == n_items and that the inter-constituent gap is uninformative — both added after v1 failed (below).

verdicts.numbers: per-token 1.000 · window linear 1.000 · window mean 0.998–1.000 · window MLP 1.000 · g −0.000 · nonlinear residual −0.000 (3σ null 0.008–0.075)
verdicts.reading: A per-token linear probe at the verb reads agreement match/mismatch PERFECTLY at layer 8. The model computes the equality itself and deposits the result at the current position, so the additive ceiling already contains everything — there is no headroom for a position-mixing code. This is the 'built-and-immediately-linearized' g(ℓ) shape from task_hunt round 1, now measured on a relational label.
verdicts.prior_scored: My frozen prior said P(violent)=0.30 and 'expect 0.75 vs 0.92'. FALSIFIED in the more-converted direction: 1.000 vs 1.000. Recorded as falsified.
verdicts.scope: One model, one hookpoint, English templates. Scoped to this label on this model.

findings.title: The gate has a positive control, so the kill is informative rather than blind
findings.body: At layer 0 with T=8, per-token reads 0.495 and the window LINEAR probe reads 0.503 — both chance — while the window MLP reaches 0.749 (0.772 in the IN stratum). This is the additive-code theorem holding on real activations: the two constituents are present in the window, no additive readout can combine them, and a cross-position nonlinearity can. The IN/OUT control confirms it is binding: the same MLP sits at 0.498 when the window cannot reach the head noun. So the instrument demonstrably fires when regime-3 headroom exists — which is what makes its zero at layers 4–24 a statement about the MODEL, not about the probe.

findings.title: Conversion is faster than the round-1 record suggested
findings.body: Per-token AUC goes 0.495 (L0) → 0.983 (L2) → 1.000 (L4) and stays there through L24. The forbidden-word candidate took ~20 layers to climb +0.13; this relational label is fully linearised per position within four. A window architecture has no hookpoint to exploit: by the depth anyone trains a dictionary at, the additive ceiling already contains everything.
